deceased_data: Data principal may nominate an individual to exercise rights on death or incapacity (s. 14)
research_exemption: Act does not apply to processing for research, archiving or statistics if per Second Schedule standards and no decision on a specific individual (s. 17(2)(b))
genetic_data: No specific rule: no sensitive or genetic data category; general consent regime applies
